title: The Garden After Rain — EN/ES/FR (Wilma McIvor)
style: folk country acoustic guitar warm female vocal 100bpm brushed drums gentle storytelling intimate garden Spanish French language learning family Perth
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
After the rain the garden has a different voice
The smell of wet earth tells you that you had no choice
But to come outside and stand in it a moment before going back in
The garden after rain is where the proper day begins

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
Después de la lluvia el jardín tiene una voz nueva
[After the rain the garden has a new voice]
La tierra mojada me dice que es hora de la prueba
[The wet earth tells me it's time for the test]
Salgo y me quedo parada un momento entre las hojas
[I come out and stand a moment among the leaves]
El jardín después de la lluvia sana todas las congojas
[The garden after rain heals all sorrows]

[Chorus — English]
The garden after rain is where I'm most myself
Everything washed clean and put back on the shelf
The garden after rain is telling me it's fine
The roots are deeper than the weather — that's the sign
The gardens still growing

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
Après la pluie le jardin a une voix différente
[After the rain the garden has a different voice]
L'odeur de la terre mouillée est purifiante
[The smell of wet earth is purifying]
Je sors dehors et je reste dans ce moment
[I come outside and stay in this moment]
Le jardin après la pluie est mon commencement
[The garden after rain is my beginning]

[Outro — All three languages]
After the rain… Después de la lluvia… Après la pluie
The garden knows — El jardín sabe — Le jardin sait
The gardens still growing
